evals.prompt: Decompose the notification-service feature into work packages
evals.expected_output: Creates wp-01-api-scaffold/ and wp-02-delivery-adapters/ each with overview.md (status: spec), todo.md, and at least one task-*.md (status: pending). Updates feature overview.md work packages table.
expectations: SKILL.md declares name: goalforge-decompose
SKILL.md input is spec.md (must exist)
SKILL.md output wp overview.md initial status is spec
SKILL.md output task-*.md initial status is pending
SKILL.md output todo.md is stamped from wp-todo.md template
SKILL.md idempotency: folder present means skip without modifying
SKILL.md WP ID format is wp-NN-<slug>
SKILL.md forbids creating files not in the Outputs table
Fixture spec.md has a 2-WP table with wp-01-api-scaffold and wp-02-delivery-adapters
Fixture spec.md has status: spec

evals.prompt: Break the payment-gateway feature down into work packages and tasks
evals.expected_output: Reads plans/payment-gateway/spec.md, creates wp-NN-* folders with overview.md (status: spec), todo.md, task files (status: pending), and updates feature overview.md WP table
expectations: SKILL.md triggers on user asking to break down or plan work packages for a feature with an approved spec.md
SKILL.md reads spec.md as the primary input
SKILL.md output overview.md initial status is spec for all newly created WPs

evals.prompt: Approve the spec for the search-indexing-pipeline feature.
evals.expected_output: goalforge-decompose should NOT trigger — approving a spec is a goalforge-spec human-gate action, not a decompose action. The skill is not applicable here.
expectations: SKILL.md trigger requires user asking to decompose or break down a feature that has an approved spec.md
A spec-approval request is outside the trigger surface of goalforge-decompose

evals.prompt: Decompose the notification-service spec; wp-01-api-scaffold/ already exists
evals.expected_output: Skips wp-01-api-scaffold entirely (idempotent). Creates wp-02-delivery-adapters/ normally if absent. Logs that wp-01-api-scaffold was already present.
expectations: SKILL.md idempotency: folder present means skip without modifying
SKILL.md logs that an already-present WP was skipped
SKILL.md does not clobber existing WP content

evals.prompt: Decompose the notification-service feature but spec.md does not exist
evals.expected_output: Skill fails: spec.md is a required input. Emits an error stating spec.md must exist before decompose can run. Does not create any WP folders.
expectations: SKILL.md input spec.md must exist (precondition)
SKILL.md does not proceed if the required spec.md input is absent
SKILL.md never creates WP folders without a valid spec.md input
